patch_description: Builds on the best-performing modular ansatz (RY → ring-CRZ → RX → skip-CRZ → diameter-CRZ, block reused twice with shared params) by inserting a lightweight, mirror-paired RZ phase layer between the RX rotation layer and the skip-2 entangler. The four new shared parameters (`rz_mid_0..3`) couple antipodal-ish qubit pairs (0&7, 1&6, 2&5, 3&4) via same-parameter RZ rotations, injecting a cheap global phase-correlation signal right where local (RX) and mid-range (skip) information mix. This is expected to sharpen local expressivity and speed convergence (as seen in the skip-2 variant's fast 150-step convergence) while retaining the diameter-CRZ global mixing and block-level parameter sharing that gave the modular design its best generalization gap (0.03) and combined score (0.89). Net cost is only +4 parameters over the strongest prior modular design.
